name: Las Cabezas de San Juan (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light green, white and light blue with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Las Cabezas de San Juan (a tower and a horse on red above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Las Cabezas de San Juan; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Las Cabezas de San Juan arms — tower and horse on red above waves
